text:
Ava: Heads-up — launch social plan needs regional stagger + localized copy. Need: X short (EN), X short (JP), LinkedIn long, two thread variants, 4 images, 15s demo clip. Schedule: US (09:00 PT), EU (17:00 CET), JP (01:00 JST).
Diego: I'll handle localized X copy (EN + JP). Tone: technical but human. For JP CTA use "詳細を見る".
Priya: I'll draft the LinkedIn longform + TL;DR benchmark bullets. Will include [CUST_SNIPPET] placeholder.
Sam: Design ETA: hero_mobile.png, hero_desktop.png, demo_15s.mp4, chart_compare.png. Need final copy by EOD for layout.
Ava: CTAs: A/B test "See benchmarks" vs "Start free trial". Use softer CTAs in APAC. Add UTMs: utm_campaign=april_launch&utm_medium=social&utm_source=twitter|linkedin.
Diego: Thread plans: Variant A -> benchmark narrative (5 tweets). Variant B -> private deploys + security angle (5 tweets). Each <280 chars.
Priya: Engagement ops: pin summary reply 4h after each regional post; 24h follow-up POV with top learnings; collect top Qs for FAQ doc.
Ava: Growth routing: DM any thread reply that says "demo" or contains "book". Also flag users with >3 likes on replies.
growth-bot: Rule created: trigger DM when reply contains "demo" OR reactions >=3. Route lead to /growth/inbound with UTM tagging.
social-bot: Scheduled posts: US=2026-04-05T09:00:00-07:00 id=post_100001; EU=2026-04-05T17:00:00+01:00 id=post_100002; JP=2026-04-06T01:00:00+09:00 id=post_100003.
Sam: Quick ask: can we include a 2s looping GIF that visualizes batching? Small file <4MB for carousel.
Ava: Yes include GIF as carousel slot 2 if <4MB.
Diego: Final checklist: copy locked by 6pm PT; assets uploaded to /designs/april_launch/ by 6pm; UTMs confirmed; scheduling locked; reply roster assigned.
Priya: I'll freeze LinkedIn longform by 5:30pm PT.
Sam: Upload confirmed by 5:55pm PT.
Ava: Sync at 5:15pm PT for final sign-off. Thanks team :rocket:
